exam_trap: 切忌在文学艺术与自然题材中机械字译为“庆祝”
example_en: a movement called Romanticism, which celebrated the wonders of the natural world.

translation_meaning: 奇观，美妙之处，壮丽景象
exam_trap: 作名词复数 wonders 时表示美妙事物或奇观，由形容词 wonderful 联想推导
example_en: celebrated the wonders of the natural world.

translation_meaning: 制定，实行，设立（规定/制度）
exam_trap: 考查动词用法，常与 policy / rule 搭配，译为“制定规矩/实行新政”
example_en: his parents had to institute a new reading policy.

exam_trap: 在家庭、学校或具体机构语境中表示内部规矩或做法，非宏观国策
example_en: institute a new reading policy in the family.

exam_trap: 核心动词短语，切忌字面译为“在上面休息”
example_en: The entire argument rests upon this premise.

translation_meaning: 匆忙作出（结论），急忙转向
exam_trap: jump to conclusion 译为“匆忙妄下结论”
example_en: One should not jump to conclusions without sufficient evidence.

exam_trap: 常作客观事实否定陈述，译为“未能/没有”，切忌生硬套用“失败”
example_en: He failed to understand the true purpose of the meeting.

exam_trap: 动词短语表示资源、时间或金钱被大肆消耗殆尽
example_en: The project ate up all our savings.

translation_meaning: 进退维谷，左右为难，尴尬处境
exam_trap: 在工作与心路历程中多译为“进退两难 / 进退维谷”，避免单薄译为两难
example_en: whose dilemma about the job translated into a lack of sales.

exam_trap: 作及物动词时译为“获取利润 / 争取到利益”
example_en: By cutting out the middleman, the farmers secure more profit.

exam_trap: cut out the middleman 经济学术语固定搭配“省去中间商环节”
example_en: By cutting out the middleman, they lowered the overall cost.

translation_meaning: 主动开始，攀谈，发起（交谈）
exam_trap: strike up a conversation 固定搭配“主动与人攀谈 / 打招呼”
example_en: strike up a conversation with someone near them.

exam_trap: 表示心理上的退缩与不情愿回避，非字面“害羞”
example_en: when we shy away from casual interactions with strangers.

translation_meaning: 真正鲜活起来，焕发生机
exam_trap: 文学与艺术语境固定习语，表示诗歌/作品被生动演绎而鲜活起来
example_en: Poems really come to life when they are recited.

translation_meaning: 渡过难关，情况出现好转
exam_trap: 比喻义短语，考研翻译中切忌望文生义译为“转弯”
example_en: Just wait, you will turn the corner, give it some time.
